results.change_intent: Add a changeset file for a patch release describing the fix for non-UTF-8 file handling.
results.summary: Standard changeset markdown file correctly configured for a patch release.

results.change_intent: Add iconv-lite and jschardet dependencies to support file encoding detection and conversion.
results.summary: Dependencies are correctly added and alphabetically sorted with appropriate version constraints.

results.change_intent: Add non-UTF-8 file encoding detection and preservation when opening diff views and saving file changes.
results.summary: The encoding check fails to match 'UTF-8' and 'ascii' properly, causing data corruption and redundant writes, and unsupported encodings can crash file opening.

issues.evidence:
const detected = chardet.detect(fileBuffer)
			this.fileEncoding =
				typeof detected === "string"
					? detected
					: detected && (detected as any).encoding
						? (detected as any).encoding
						: "utf8"
			this.originalContent = iconv.decode(fileBuffer, this.fileEncoding)
issues.comment: chardet.detect can detect encodings that iconv-lite does not support (such as UTF-32LE, UTF-32BE, or unsupported code pages). Passing an unsupported encoding to iconv.decode will throw an unhandled 'Encoding not recognized' error and crash open().
issues.suggestion: Validate that iconv-lite supports the detected encoding using iconv.encodingExists() before assigning and decoding, falling back to 'utf8' if unsupported.
issues.suggested_code:
const detected = chardet.detect(fileBuffer)
			const detectedEncoding = typeof detected === "string" ? detected : detected?.encoding
			this.fileEncoding = detectedEncoding && iconv.encodingExists(detectedEncoding) ? detectedEncoding : "utf8"
			this.originalContent = iconv.decode(fileBuffer, this.fileEncoding)

issues.comment: jschardet reports UTF-8 as 'UTF-8' (with a hyphen) and plain ASCII files as 'ascii'. Checking fileEncoding.toLowerCase() !== 'utf8' evaluates to true for 'utf-8', causing redundant disk writes on all UTF-8 files. More seriously, files detected as 'ascii' will be re-encoded with iconv.encode(..., 'ascii'), which corrupts any non-ASCII characters added during editing into question marks (?). Additionally, writing directly to disk after showTextDocument has opened the document can cause editor desync or file change conflicts.
issues.suggestion: Check for both 'utf8', 'utf-8', and 'ascii' (or normalize by stripping non-alphanumeric characters) before deciding to re-encode, since ASCII text is fully valid UTF-8 and should not be constrained to 7-bit ASCII on save. Also ensure any file rewrite happens before calling showTextDocument.

results.change_intent: Add encoding detection using jschardet and iconv-lite to properly decode non-UTF-8 files and prevent misclassifying them as binary.
results.summary: The changes introduce a regression by reading entire files before checking file size, bypass binary file detection because jschardet detects arbitrary binary files as single-byte text, and fail to verify whether detected encodings are supported by iconv-lite.

issues.comment: Reading the entire file into a buffer before checking its size defeats the size limit check. For large files (e.g. multi-gigabyte files), this can cause significant memory pressure or crash the process with ERR_FS_FILE_TOO_LARGE. The file size should be inspected prior to reading the buffer (and getFileSizeInKB, imported on line 7, is now left unused).
issues.suggestion: Check the file size with getFileSizeInKB before reading the file into memory.

issues.comment: isBinaryFile is only checked inside the else branch when chardet.detect returns no encoding. However, jschardet almost always detects an encoding (such as windows-1252 or ISO-8859-2) for arbitrary binary files like images, executables, and archives. As a result, the else branch is never reached, binary detection is bypassed, and binary files will be decoded as text and returned instead of throwing the expected error.
issues.suggestion: Keep binary file validation active for binary files rather than only running it as a fallback when chardet fails to return an encoding.

issues.comment: jschardet can detect encodings that iconv-lite does not support (e.g. UTF-32LE, UTF-32BE, ISO-2022-KR, EUC-TW). When an unsupported encoding name is passed to iconv.decode, iconv-lite throws an unhandled error ('Encoding not recognized'). Additionally, jschardet.detect returns an IDetectResult object, never a string, making typeof detected === 'string' dead code.
issues.suggestion: Check iconv.encodingExists(detectedEncoding) before passing the encoding to iconv.decode, and fall back to 'utf8' if it is not supported.
